subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: Fly Manila to Beijing on Air China and connect to Harbin for a winter tour of Yabuli, Mudanjiang and Harbin, including Harbin Ice-Snow World and the Siberian Tiger Park. The tour ends with a night in Beijing and free time at Wangfujing before flying home. Hotels are 5-star, including the Crowne Plaza Harbin or similar. A private coach and English-speaking guide are included.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 29–Jan 4 2026 to Dec 29–Jan 4 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Yabuli Ski Resort: One of China's largest ski resorts, passed on the way to Mudanjiang (skiing not included).
placeDesc.Mudanjiang: A city in Heilongjiang province in China's far northeast, where the group stays overnight.
placeDesc.Chateau Volga: A Russian-style manor park near Harbin with snow activities and a vodka tasting stop.
placeDesc.St. Nicholas Church: A Russian Orthodox-style church at Chateau Volga, visited on Day 3.
placeDesc.Vodka Fort: A stop at Chateau Volga where guests enjoy a small vodka and snack.
placeDesc.Pushkin Exhibition Hall: An exhibition at Chateau Volga about the Russian poet Alexander Pushkin.
placeDesc.Songhua River: The river running through Harbin, with riverside promenades and winter activities.
placeDesc.Stalin Park: A riverside park on the Songhua River in Harbin.
placeDesc.Central Street: Harbin's historic pedestrian street lined with European-style buildings.
placeDesc.Flood Control Monument: A riverside monument in Harbin beside the Songhua River.
placeDesc.Sophia Church Square: The square in front of Harbin's well-known Byzantine-style Saint Sophia Cathedral.
placeDesc.Middle East Railway Bridge: An old railway bridge across the Songhua River in Harbin.
placeDesc.Harbin Ice-Snow World: Harbin's winter attraction of large ice and snow sculptures, visited on Day 4.
placeDesc.Siberian Tiger Park: A park in Harbin devoted to Siberian tigers.
placeDesc.Baroque-style Old Street: One of Harbin's best-preserved streets of Baroque-style old buildings.
placeDesc.Giant Snowman Sculpture: A giant snowman sculpture in Harbin, visited with the music corridor on Day 6.
placeDesc.Wangfujing Walking Street: A busy pedestrian shopping street in central Beijing, with free time on the last day.
